text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE P2 - goldcrest-prod (VPC/Dedicated) tool/function-calling errors reported by CS. Error rate spike 22% over 5m, impact: failed toolcall responses -> customer transactions delayed. Paging oncall. link: https://redwood.internal/inc/1824567890 :rotating_light:

jordan: got the page, looking. can someone paste the failing log lines?

maria: i'm oncall. seeing a flood of `ToolCallParserError: unexpected field \"meta\"` from the fncall handler in the dedicated pool for goldcrest. appears after a recent client-side rollout.

lee: logs attached from edge: ```
2026-05-03T14:12:17Z ERROR fncall_parser.cpp:128 parse() - unexpected field \"meta\" in payload, schema v2 expected [name,args]
2026-05-03T14:12:18Z WARN routing.cpp:72 falling back to safe-tool-v1 for tenant goldcrest
```

jordan: so schema drift. client started sending a top-level `meta` object in tool arguments. parser strict mode fails. impact: about 12% of requests in pool rejected vs just timed out.

ashley-cs: customer reports 400s in their telemetry and complains their scheduled jobs are failing. They pushed a change last night. Asking for ETA to restore.

maria: quick plan: 1) enable permissive parser shim on the dedicated pool for goldcrest to accept top-level `meta` for 30m; 2) route new requests to fallback model variant with tolerant toolcall adapter; 3) ask CS to roll back client diff if they can.

lee: i can flip the shim. it's a safe change in runtime config: `enable_fncall_compat=true` scoped to tenant. patch applied via ops-config: `tenant.goldcrest.fncall.compat=permissive`

ops-rotator: applying config change now (will patch 3 nodes sequentially to avoid blips). ETA ~3m. rolling patch id: ops/1824567890-shim1

incident-bot: change deployed to node-12 (ok), node-13 (ok), node-14 (in-progress) — progress logs: OK,OK,IN_PROGRESS

lee: once shim in, we should see parsing errors drop. i'll also add a quick normalization shim in the router that strips `meta` into `args.meta` for compatibility.

jordan: maria, can you coordinate a temporary routing rule to send goldcrest traffic to fallback model `rvx-safe-compat` while we validate? we want to avoid quality regressions.

maria: doing it now. adding route rule `if tenant==goldcrest -> model=rvx-safe-compat` backend=dedicated-pool-3 (capacity available). applied.

incident-bot: routing change applied: 100% of new requests matched. old in-flight requests still hitting pre-change nodes.

ashley-cs: passing update to customer: "We've applied a compatibility shim and routed new traffic to a tolerant model variant. We're monitoring. Will keep you posted."

lee: parsing errors dropped from 22% -> 1.8% in last 90s. looks good.

jordan: nice. next steps: 1) run retrospective with CS and product to understand client change and make schema versioning clearer; 2) keep shim live for 2 hours then remove if no further regressions; 3) file ticket to add explicit schema version header + automated compatibility tests.

maria: i'll own the runbook follow-ups. filing incident ticket: INC-2026-589 - Goldcrest fncall parser drift. adding logs and timeline.

ops-rotator: patch finished on node-14, health checks green.

ashley-cs: customer acknowledged the temporary mitigation and will attempt a quick rollback on their side. they asked for a short postmortem.

jordan: handing off to maria for postmortem actions. i'm dropping from page. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: taking handoff. will coordinate with CS for PM and update the jira with RCA and mitigations. marking incident as resolved for pager rotation, monitoring for 2h. :eyes:

incident-bot: incident status -> MONITORED. severity lowered to P3. close-window starts in 2h unless re-escalated.

lee: note for eng-runtime: consider adding a permissive parsing mode flag at routing layer and a per-tenant compatibility matrix. will spin a proposal.

ashley-cs: i put a placeholder in the customer comms doc. thanks team.

maria: closing thread here, will post the PM when ready.
